revisions.goal: Reduce idle CPU usage from the EVE local UI by lowering unnecessary background polling and avoiding repeated expensive refreshes while preserving eventual freshness for snapshots, repositories, and plan request state.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria: The UI no longer aggressively refetches snapshot/repository/plan data every five seconds in background tabs; fast-changing pending state still refreshes often enough for approval workflows; tests cover the new query refresh policy; relevant verification passes.

milestones.title: Measure idle refresh path
milestones.goal: Identify expensive routes repeatedly hit by the open UI and establish a targeted test or benchmark signal.

milestones.title: Tune live query policy
milestones.goal: Reduce global background polling and limit frequent refresh to pending/active workflows.

milestones.title: Verify and record
milestones.goal: Run focused tests, commit implementation, record the EVE snapshot, and commit the generated product-history record.

revisions.configuredSuite: go test ./cmd/eve ./... and npm tests for the UI query refresh policy
